flora: Hardy drought-resistant ferns (stiff, leathery fronds, low-growing)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; fronds have a thick, leathery, almost 'succulent' appearance; rounded edges to the leaflets; dusty green and bronze tones to suggest heat-resistance; focus on a resilient and ancient feel.

visual_logic.composition: A close-up, ground-level view of a cluster of hardy ferns nestled in the shadow of a large, ochre-colored boulder. The leathery texture of the leaves is the primary focus.
visual_logic.ground: Variegated red earth with small, chalky nodules and a thin layer of wind-blown sand.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; dappled light hitting the ferns as it peeks around the boulder, creating high-contrast texture on the leathery fronds.
